title: The glossary check finds GLOSSARY.md the same from the installed copy and from the repo
why:
Finding from lane notes-sessionend-limits, relayed by the coordinator at 00:15 CST Nov 15 (the lane's report; the coordinator did not re-read it): the installed ~/.claude/lint/check_glossary.py reads GLOSSARY.md under ~/.claude, where none exists, so a run from the installed copy fails on the read while the repo copy passes. Triage read it at 00:15 CST Nov 15 on the cloud machine: the installed copy and the repo copy (/root/claude-settings-main/lint/check_glossary.py) are byte-identical (diff silent); ROOT is the parent of the script's own folder (check_glossary.py line 60), so the installed copy looks for /root/.claude/GLOSSARY.md, which does not exist, and the repo copy finds /root/claude-settings-main/GLOSSARY.md; running the installed copy printed 'check_glossary: FAIL: GLOSSARY.md cannot be read'. Triage ran it with plain python3 -I (the verdict command is not on the cloud machine). Not a debt: one lane hit it, no repeated incident yet. Root fix in a code lane: the check finds GLOSSARY.md the same from the installed copy and the repo (for example by asking git for the repo root or by a root the installer writes), and reads a missing GLOSSARY.md as a refusal that names the path it tried, never as a silent pass. Kin: step glossary-outside-repo-unknown (the check passes a file it never reads; the opposite failure on the same file). Check to add: a test that runs the installed copy from a folder with no GLOSSARY.md beside it.
